usage: agentware graph add-node [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                                [--checkpoint {none,review,manual}]
                                name feature

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name
  feature               plan feature slug (the node)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --checkpoint {none,review,manual}
                        checkpoint policy (default: read from the plan.md)
